description: How the positional test path patterns narrow Jest's --listTests (U2, T11.13): each is a regular expression, tested without regard to case on the path from the root and on the absolute path, and a file any of them matches is kept. `^lib/three` is anchored to the start of the path from the root. The list is recorded sorted. Jest only.

jest.src/Two.test.ts: // matched by the pattern two, without regard to case
jest.other/lib/three.test.ts: // not matched: ^lib/three is anchored to the root
